title: SCORED FROM 40 YARDS, SENT OFF SEVEN MINUTES LATER: RONALDINHO VS ENGLAND
description:
Two goals at the Bernabéu, and Real Madrid fans applauded the enemy.

Ronaldinho's career is basically a string of plot twists. In 2002 against England he scored a forty-yard free kick past Seaman. Seven minutes later he was sent off. Hero to early bath, instantly.

In 2005 he won the Ballon d'Or and FIFA's World Player again. At the Bernabéu he scored twice, and the home crowd clapped.

Then Fluminense, 2015: nine official games, no goals, no assists. Compare that with the 2013 Copa Libertadores, where he made eight assists.

Which Ronaldinho is the real one: the free-kick hero, the red card or the Bernabéu showman? Drop your pick.

Your mates will never guess this one. More at https://aboutfootball.uk, plus news, free tips and predictions.
